query: Trump job approval polls week August 24 2026

results.content:
## Timeline

Aug. 24Trump’s approval rating held at 33% in the latest Reuters/Ipsos poll released Monday, unchanged from the groups’ survey released Aug. 17, while his disapproval rating increased one point, to 65% (the survey of 1,215 adults was conducted Aug. 21-24 and has a margin of error of 3).

Just 31% support U.S. military action in Iran, down from 34% earlier this month and 37% in March.
results.title: Trump’s Approval Rating Dips To Second-Term Low
